On the first swallow, AD_DGST computes the digestion timer from constitution, armor class, rn2(20), and the swallower level; later swallowed attacks decrement that timer, apply the AD_DGST damage/message/strength-exercise rules, handle physical damage and lifesaving, and expel when the source conditions require it. The step-135 witness is a Purple Worm swallowing the hero, so the later monster-to-monster action is not the first cause.
